invariants.rationale: instantTime is required for version control and is passed to the handle and constructors.
partitionPath identifies where records are written; it should not be null at insertion.
fileId specifies the file to which records are written; null would likely cause errors.
recordMap holds the records to insert; must not be null to process the insert.
It's likely the method expects to insert at least one record; an empty map would be a no-op.
